description: Derive a Solana program-derived address (find_program_address, bump 255 down to 1) with no RPC and no payment. Pass program + recipe + inputs for a known recipe (e.g. program=associated-token-account, recipe=associated-token-address, inputs={wallet, mint}; program=metaplex-token-metadata, recipe=metadata, inputs={mint}; program=pump-fun, recipe=bonding-curve, inputs={mint}), or program_id + seeds as kind:value lines (str:, pk:, u8…u128 / i8…i128 little-endian, u64be, hex:, b64:, sha256:) with optional bump. topic=catalog lists programs; topic=program lists one program's recipes; topic=with_seed runs create_with_seed(base, seed, owner); topic=on_curve checks an address. Same data as GET /api/pda. The result is an address only; it does not check whether an account exists.

bump.description: Optional fixed bump (0-255) for create_program_address instead of searching.

inputs.description: Recipe inputs by seed name, e.g. {"wallet": "<base58>", "mint": "<base58>"}. Recipes that run under any program also need program_id.

program.description: Program slug (see topic=catalog) or program ID, e.g. associated-token-account, pump-fun, orca-whirlpools.

program_id.description: Program ID for raw seeds, or for recipes such as anchor/event-authority that run under any program.

recipe.description: Recipe slug within the program, e.g. associated-token-address, metadata, bonding-curve, whirlpool.

seeds.description: Raw seeds as kind:value, newline- or |-separated (or an array), e.g. ["str:metadata", "pk:<program>", "pk:<mint>"].

topic.description: Defaults from the other fields: derive when recipe or seeds is set, with_seed when base is set, on_curve when address is set, else catalog.

name: derive_solana_pda
title: Derive a Solana PDA from a known recipe or raw seeds (free)
